run_ppo_training: run PPO training on a Mujoco Playground environment with configurable hyperparameters and logging
get_rl_config: get RL configuration for a specified environment name from manipulation, locomotion, or dm_control suites
run_play_only: run play-only mode to evaluate a trained checkpoint without training a new policy
run_with_wandb: run training with Weights & Biases logging for experiment tracking and metrics visualization
run_with_vision: run PPO training with vision input using camera-based observations instead of state observations
